setup.command: cd /tmp && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.8.6/install.sh -o uv-install.sh && echo '6879d086185d40aa08dbbfb91f4c982badb563f1591939d8fa255efc6ee1f1cd  uv-install.sh' | sha256sum --check --strict && sudo env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh uv-install.sh && curl -fsSLO https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.13.1/node-v22.13.1-linux-x64.tar.xz && curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.13.1/SHASUMS256.txt | grep ' node-v22.13.1-linux-x64.tar.xz$' | sha256sum --check --strict && sudo tar -xJf node-v22.13.1-linux-x64.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --exclude CHANGELOG.md --exclude LICENSE --exclude README.md && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pandoc
